name: AK Rail Extension
description_html:
Huge thanks to WTT members, especially Tron who notes the modding guidance. I cannot make this mod come true without their advice.

Note: Sadly, this mod will no longer support KALASHNIKOV ENHANCED MODDING and stop updating.

The good news is you shall see these accessories in KALASHNIKOV ENHANCED MODDING in the future.

AK railextension

Nikita,

traitor of Russian Federal and Kalashnikov,

the COO of Battlestate Games,

said the following about the removal of Tactical Tula 10000 on Reddit:

“Its unrealistic to have such kind of magic rail that you can just screw in everywhere.”

AK platform is too weak to fight with western firearms because of low modificative level and poor ammunition.

Now, I bring the TT 10000 back from the ancient era. What’s more, there are more devils waiting for Tarkov.

Skier/Mechanics with tier 1~4.

There are several items that can enhance the experience of AK system:

Tactical Tula 10000 mount, good old days.

AK TWS Dog Leg Beryl-style Rail, additional rear sight/ upper receiver/ mount rail for AK platform, you can also leave the receiver nude. (AK mechanics is hot🥵)

POPC Gen 4 mount rail, from the Polish Beryl weapon system, of course you can 🥵🥵🥵🥵🥵🥵🥵🥵🥵🥵

SAG MK 2/2.1 & MK 3 Chassis

And more……

Feed your enemies in Tarkov some 5.45/7.62 snacks, with , from Kalashnikov.
